method: Exact UCI prefixes from accepted native histories, including the common standard start at zero plies. Prefix lengths fixed descriptively at 0/2/4/8/16/24/32; games shorter than a requested length are excluded and eligibility is explicit. Pairwise common-prefix lengths describe all unordered pairs, with within-color subsets shown separately. Groups overlap across lengths; do not sum them.
limits: Native descriptive counts only. Ten unique complete histories per color do not establish independent samples. Same standard start, shared prefixes and paired games remain correlated. No bootstrap or population claims for unaided starts; no mechanism or weakness attribution.
